INPUT arr, target

left <- 0
right <- length(arr)-1

WHILE left <= right:
    mid <- (left + right) DIV 2

    IF arr[mid] == target:
        RETURN mid

    IF arr[left] <= arr[mid]:
        IF arr[left] <= target AND target < arr[mid]:
            right <- mid - 1
        ELSE:
            left <- mid + 1
    ELSE:
        IF arr[mid] < target AND target <= arr[right]:
            left <- mid + 1
        ELSE:
            right <- mid - 1

RETURN -1
